description: Ideally located close to the Eiffel Tower, this home was fully renovated in a contemporary style to offer an elegant retreat for your stay in Paris. Let yourself be carried away by the stunning views over the Eiffel Tower and Parisian buildings, from the comfort of the living room and two of the bedrooms. Enjoy 3 comfortable bedrooms, each benefiting from its own en-suite bathroom. Last but not least, the hidden rooftop terrace is an unexpected oasis in the center of the cityThe spaceImportant: No elevator in the building - the apartment is accessible through the stairs on the 2nd floor.Need to store your luggage? We can help arrange its pickup before your arrival and after your departure, contact us!The apartment includes: - 1 Living room- 1 Dining area with seating for 6- 1 Fully equipped kitchen- 3 Private bathrooms (see below)- 2 Separate WCsThe sleeping arrangement is organized as follows: - Bedroom 1 with a Kingsize bed and en-suite private bathroom (bath and no WC)- Bedroom 2 with a Kingsize bed and en-suite private bathroom (shower and no WC)- Bedroom 3 with a Kingsize bed and en-suite private bathroom (shower and no WC)- Living room convertible into a bedroom: 1 sofa bed for two people The apartment can accommodate up to 6 people.The surface area is 130 m² / 1408 sq ft The apartment is equipped with:- A/C- Bath and bed linen- 5-star bedding - Toiletries (shower gel, shampoo, conditioner, toilet paper)- High speed Wifi- TV- Washer dryer - Hair dryer- Nespresso coffee machine- Water boiler- Toaster - Fridge- Induction cooking plates- Combined microwave oven- Pans and other cooking wares- Baby bed and high chair if neededWe have curated a selection of services and experiences with trusted partners to elevate your Parisian stay. From a private Chef preparing a meal
